title: P36: hub_key is 32 bytes, local, not zeroized
description: protocol-06 §5.4.1.2 server_frank = HMAC-SHA256 keyed by hub_key, with no length or management stated. Chosen: HubKey is a fixed 32-byte key (SHA-256 output size; RFC 2104 recommends at least L bytes), local to the hub and never on the wire. Debug redacts it. Not zeroized on drop (zeroize is not an approved dependency; noted in # Limitations). Key rotation/identification is a wg item.
